---
title: "Environment Summary"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  plot_numbers: ""
  site_unit: ""
  project_id: ""
  colour_greater: 5
  gray_greater: 65
  apply_theme: true
  report_title: "Environment Summary"
  project_root: ""
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Env", "Sample_SU")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(params$plot_number, params$plot_numbers)
if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  su_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_SU WHERE SiteUnit = ?",
    list(trimws(params$site_unit))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(su_df$PlotNumber))
}
if (length(plots) == 0 && nzchar(trimws(params$project_id)) && DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_Env")) {
  env_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT PlotNumber FROM Sample_Env WHERE ProjectID = ?",
    list(trimws(params$project_id))
  )
  plots <- unique(as.character(env_df$PlotNumber))
}

plots <- plots[nzchar(plots)]
if (length(plots) > 0) {
  plot_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, plots), collapse = ", ")
  env <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("SELECT * FROM Sample_Env WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s)", plot_sql))
} else {
  env <- data.frame()
}

site_unit_map <- data.frame()
if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "Sample_SU")) {
  site_unit_map <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT PlotNumber, SiteUnit FROM Sample_SU")
}

unit_names <- data.frame()
if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "lists.MasterSiteUnitList")) {
  unit_names <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT SiteSeries, SiteSeriesLongName FROM lists.MasterSiteUnitList")
}

normalize_env_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  map <- list(
    plotnumber = c("plotnumber", "PlotNumber"),
    projectid = c("projectid", "ProjectID"),
    date = c("date", "Date"),
    sitesurveyor = c("sitesurveyor", "SiteSurveyor"),
    latitude = c("latitude", "Latitude"),
    longitude = c("longitude", "Longitude"),
    elevation = c("elevation", "Elevation"),
    aspect = c("aspect", "Aspect"),
    slopegradient = c("slopegradient", "SlopeGradient"),
    mesoslopeposition = c("mesoslopeposition", "MesoSlopePosition"),
    surfaceshape = c("surfaceshape", "SurfaceShape"),
    moistureregime = c("moistureregime", "MoistureRegime"),
    nutrientregime = c("nutrientregime", "NutrientRegime"),
    sitenotes = c("sitenotes", "SiteNotes")
  )
  for (target in names(map)) {
    source <- pick_col(map[[target]])
    if (!is.na(source)) df[[target]] <- df[[source]]
  }
  df
}

env <- normalize_env_cols(env)
if (nrow(env) > 0 && nrow(site_unit_map) > 0) {
  site_unit_map <- dplyr::rename(site_unit_map, plotnumber = PlotNumber, siteunit = SiteUnit)
  env <- dplyr::left_join(env, site_unit_map, by = "plotnumber")
}
if (nrow(env) > 0 && nrow(unit_names) > 0) {
  unit_names <- dplyr::rename(unit_names, siteunit = SiteSeries, siteunit_long = SiteSeriesLongName)
  env <- dplyr::left_join(env, unit_names, by = "siteunit")
}

if (nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit))) {
  env <- env[env$siteunit == trimws(params$site_unit), , drop = FALSE]
}

if (nrow(env) > 0) {
  desired <- c("plotnumber", "siteunit", "siteunit_long", "projectid", "date", "sitesurveyor", "latitude", "longitude", "elevation",
               "aspect", "slopegradient", "mesoslopeposition", "surfaceshape", "moistureregime",
               "nutrientregime", "sitenotes")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(env))
  env <- env[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

# `r params$report_title`

# Plot: `r if (length(plots) > 0) plots[1] else params$plot_number`

```{r env-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(env) > 0) {
  if ("siteunit" %in% names(env)) {
    env <- env[order(env$siteunit, env$plotnumber), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  apply_theme <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)
  colour_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$colour_greater))
  gray_greater <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$gray_greater))
  if (apply_theme && nrow(env) > 0) {
    style_numeric <- function(vec) {
      labels <- as.character(vec)
      vapply(seq_along(labels), function(i) {
        label <- labels[[i]]
        if (!nzchar(label)) return("")
        num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(label))
        if (is.na(num)) return(label)
        bg <- ""
        if (!is.na(gray_greater) && num >= gray_greater) {
          bg <- "#e6e6e6"
        } else if (!is.na(colour_greater) && num >= colour_greater) {
          bg <- "#f9e27d"
        }
        if (nzchar(bg)) kableExtra::cell_spec(label, background = bg) else label
      }, character(1))
    }
    num_cols <- names(env)[vapply(env, is.numeric, logical(1))]
    if (length(num_cols) == 0) {
      num_cols <- intersect(c("latitude", "longitude", "elevation", "aspect", "slopegradient"), names(env))
    }
    for (col_name in num_cols) {
      env[[col_name]] <- style_numeric(env[[col_name]])
    }
  }

  kbl(env, align = "l", escape = !apply_theme) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No environment data found.")
}
```
